verification.criterion: Manifest reconciles reported versus historical RAM/CPU and records hardware health and exact runtime identities.
Three fresh four-device probe runs pass exact transfer checksums without timeout/device loss; bounded >4 GiB tests included.
Required quant/attention/routing fixtures and same-pack real-layer/logit reference comparisons pass frozen tolerances.
Complete 2.00-bit model passes three cold starts, mixed expert routing and multi-token parity within measured memory budgets.
Ownership mocks, serving checks, 300-second idle/resume and two-hour soak pass without affecting production stand-ins.
Reproducible correctness-qualified A/B results record variance, memory and latency; no unmeasured throughput promise.
Clean-directory build/launch is reproducible from pinned sources and manifests with rollback instructions.
Final implementation diff excludes rejected/deferred complexity unless a new decision and gate explicitly qualifies it.
